remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -DUSE_NEW_WINE_REGISTER_RESOURCES)

spec2def(mscoree.dll mscoree.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No CONST_VTABLE

# mscoree.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mscoree-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(mscoree_shims OBJECT assembly.c config.c cordebug.c corruntimehost.c metadata.c metahost.c mscoree_main.c reactos.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(mscoree_shims PRIVATE uuid wine oldnames libdbghelp libadvapi32 libshell32 libkernel32_vista libole32 libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(mscoree_shims)
add_cargo_module(mscoree mscoree-cargo mscoree.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mscoree_shims psdk uuid_sources)
